resources.string: Shifter uses your precise location while the app is open to check you in automatically when you arrive at your mission.
Location access denied. Without it you cannot be checked in automatically: ask your manager to check you in.
Location access denied: an approximate location cannot tell if you are at your mission. Allow the precise location to be checked in automatically.
Location access denied. To be checked in automatically, allow the precise location in the app settings.
Location is turned off. Turn it on to be checked in automatically.
Your team\'s manager can see where you are while the event runs. It is updated as you move.
Your manager does not see your position yet. It will be sent as soon as your phone has both a location and a connection.
The server refused your position, so your manager does not see it. This happens when the event is over or you are no longer in its team.
Sharing is on, but Shifter cannot read your position. Allow location access for Shifter in your phone\'s settings.
Your team\'s manager cannot see where you are during this event.
You can turn sharing off in Settings.
You can turn sharing on in Settings.
